name: Gamma
desc: Turns a prompt into a deck, doc or webpage
desc_zh: 一句话变出演示稿、文档或网页
solves: A blank first slide is a blank page. One sentence produces a laid-out deck; the cards move like ordinary blocks afterwards.
solves_zh: 空白的第一页就是一张白纸。一句话先出排好版的 deck，之后按卡片继续改。
best_for: A deck needed today, with the content already formed in your head.
best_for_zh: 今天就要拿出去一份能看的 deck，内容已经在脑子里成形。
notes: The most-used AI presentation tool by a wide margin, and its card-based editor changed how people think about slides. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20250915A0244F00
